mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, provider, api_key AS apiKey, base_url AS baseUrl, max_results AS maxResults, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM web_search_config WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO web_search_config (user_id, provider, api_key, base_url, max_results) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{apiKey}, #{baseUrl}, #{maxResults}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider = VALUES(provider), api_key = VALUES(api_key), base_url = VALUES(base_url), max_results = VALUES(max_results)
